svg.title: Mediterraneo cruiser recognition drawing
svg.desc: Original WNT1922 Mediterraneo cruiser recognition illustration. Port profile and deck plan share one hull length and equipment stations. Dimensions and unspecified layout are illustration choices. Fitted catalog main battery: 8 barrels. Internal submarine tubes are not depicted as exposed deck mounts.
